name: Prescribed Fire rx-Lapham Good Oak 2026, Waukesha, Wisconsin
summary: Across the event of 2026-11-18: between 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-18, HH backscatter here changed by +0.6 dB and HV by -0.0 dB (mean within 500 m). Across the mapped area, 3% got at least 3 dB weaker and 0% at least 3 dB stronger.
method: NISAR L2 GCOV (terrain-corrected gamma-naught), frequency A, 4 passes on track 012-D-067-QPDH. Time series: mean linear power within 500 m of the point, in dB.
